A1.justification: Both readable 11-page PDFs describe the same CCCaption work, with comparable text, equations, figures and tables. Neither contains an appendix; the supplementary materials mentioned in both are not included in either supplied PDF.

before.justification: v1 reports original CCCaption-2B evaluations in Tables 1–3, training-data and component ablations in Tables 4–5, and qualitative and training analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains these original evaluations, ablations and analyses, including the CCCaption-2B results in Tables 1–5.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same completeness and correctness rewards, multi-MLLM query generation, dynamic query sampling and combined reinforcement-learning objective. Algorithm 1 and the proposed procedure are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use CCaption-44k and the same datasets and tasks under Prism, Hallucinations and CapArena evaluation. The MathVista/ChartQA training analysis and MMBench examples are also retained.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons in Tables 1–5 retain the same models and ablation variants. CapRL-3B and the LVLM comparators are unchanged, as are the Claude, MiniCPM and CogVLM2 opponents in CapArena.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 retain the same evaluation procedures, judge models and training settings, including 600 CapArena battles, reward weight 0.05, rollout count 5, learning rate 1e-6 and 20 epochs. Text reflow does not introduce new settings.

E4.justification: Both retain the training-data and component ablations in Tables 4–5, caption case studies in Figure 3, embedding analysis in Figure 4 and dynamic-sampling comparison in Figure 5. Removing 'and ablation studies' from an introductory bullet does not remove these analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed information, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests for the experimental results. The stated rollout count concerns training, not independent experimental repetitions.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–5 and the plotted and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, CCCaption-2B retains average scores of 46.39 in CapArena, 52.80 in Prism and 70.57 in Hallucinations evaluation.

T1.justification: Equations 1–8 retain the same mathematical content, including the completeness/correctness definitions, query-diversity statistic, sampling rule and combined reward. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the claims about dual-reward captioning, CCaption-44k, sampling efficiency and CCCaption-2B performance. The shortened contribution bullet does not alter these claims or the retained ablation evidence.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 retains the same explanations of query coverage, sampling efficiency and hallucination suppression. The conclusion's proposed refinement of evaluation metrics is unchanged, and no substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added.

D1.justification: The documented code repository changes from ZhijiangTang/CCCaption to Shopee-MUG/CCCaption. New acknowledgments identify Shopee as providing computing support. Section 4.2's implementation details remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish any change to the implementation itself.

R1.justification: The same 62 reference entries and related-work discussion are retained, including the positioning against CapRL. Changed citation back-reference page numbers reflect reflow rather than different cited works.

P1.justification: v2 updates author contribution and affiliation notes, adds acknowledgments, shortens an introductory contribution bullet and rephrases the Table 5 caption. The scientific narrative and section order otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The author block wraps differently, spacing around figures and tables changes, and text reflows so the conclusion fits on page 8. Printed page numbers are removed. All five figures and five tables retain their graphical content and structure, with a small Table 5 caption edit.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the same method, mathematical argument, experimental evidence and interpretations. The attribution, acknowledgment, code-address and modest presentation updates do not establish a meaningful overall quality gain or loss; the changed repository address alone does not demonstrate improved reproducibility.
